title: Rate Memorandum — Daily Late Fee Relief by Lease Term Length
content:
The allowed daily late fee on an Apartment Home Lease under a late fee review follows the current Lease Term Agreement: a term of 13 months or longer takes $4.00 off the floor plan's daily late fee, a term of 10 to 12 months takes $2.00 off it, and a shorter term leaves it as it is.

**Record read.** The term length in months of the customer's Lease Term Agreement in current status for the lease. A lease with no current Lease Term Agreement on record is treated as a shorter term and keeps the floor plan's daily late fee.

## Relief schedule

| Current Lease Term Agreement length | Allowed daily late fee |
|---|---|
| 13 months or longer | the floor plan's daily late fee less $4.00 |
| 10 to 12 months | the floor plan's daily late fee less $2.00 |
| 9 months or shorter | the floor plan's daily late fee |

**Boundaries.** A 12-month term takes $2.00 off; a 13-month term takes $4.00 off. A 9-month term takes nothing off; a 10-month term takes $2.00 off.

## Resulting daily late fee by floor plan

| Floor plan | Floor plan daily late fee | Term of 13 months or longer | Term of 10 to 12 months | Shorter term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | $10.00 | $6.00 | $8.00 | $10.00 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | $10.00 | $6.00 | $8.00 | $10.00 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | $12.00 | $8.00 | $10.00 | $12.00 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | $12.00 | $8.00 | $10.00 | $12.00 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | $15.00 | $11.00 | $13.00 | $15.00 |
| Penthouse Residence | $20.00 | $16.00 | $18.00 | $20.00 |
